description: PO lateness: over live captures the L7 probe (scripts.ontology_projection_probe --build-only) builds or reuses the session projection; then, offline and with no client, scripts.po_lateness_probe calls plx.process with no process name through the served host as its capture principal on up to 400 PurchaseOrder roots the reader's policy grants (lowest SHA-256 of the object id first). An unnamed call answers po_delivery_window exactly when the PO is open by the graph's open_when, the shared purchase-order status definition (operating.po_status: header not cancelled or draft and its lines' received quantity below the ordered one); those are the open POs. Recorded: open POs, open POs with a governing planned date and its share (target >= 0.8, recorded, not asserted), the counts late and at risk (Vince's rule: late once the requested-by date has passed; at risk while the supplier's latest promise is after it), lateness states, reasons and gap reasons by count, the governing date's source property by count, and up to 3 sample reason chains of late open POs with their cited dates as property, source relation, field path and authority rank only (never a value, key, identifier or l1 handle). Pass = no contract failure, no process error, budget held. Live-unverified until the live check records a result.
notes: Registered, live-unverified: no live-check result yet. Module test: injected-transport (verify/tests/test_live_po_lateness.py runs this spec's own argv over the fixture world with the Portal and BC transports injected and checks it with live_verify.check_expectations; only the live size floor and the live-read label may miss there). The governing share is data for the >= 80% target, never a pass or failure. Session projection, disk and timing as process.dependencies (same build, same session reads).
